_doc: The four first-version features. Each row lists the sheet rows that implement it; preflight checks every reference resolves.

rows.name: Stereo VR view, head tracked, flat menus on a floating screen
rows.status: two-eye render verified in game with synthetic eyes; headset not tested

rows.name: Cockpit flying and on-foot movement with a virtual gamepad driven by the controllers
Hand controllers on foot: tools, building, grabbing
rows.status: partial: buttons and triggers work through the pad, hand poses are read, aiming still follows the head

rows.name: Wrist menu and toolbar without keyboard or mouse
rows.status: not built: toolbar next/previous on the grips, menu button opens the game menu
